subject: Proposed staggered demo windows — US / EU / APAC exec availability
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Torres <elaine.torres@brightbyte.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@brightbyte.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 15:23:00 -0400
Subject: Staggered demo windows — initial proposal

Hi Elaine / Rajiv,

Thanks again for the openness to run a product deep-dive with your execs. Because we have stakeholders in the US, Europe and APAC, and a couple of execs with hard constraints, Sergio and I sketched a couple of staggered windows (shorter, back-to-back regional blocks) to keep the group together for the core demo but avoid forcing anyone into unreasonable hours.

High-level options (all times local and approximate, we'll send proper invites once we lock):
- Option A: Single 90-minute overlap at 17:00 EDT / 22:00 BST / 06:00 JST (next day) — heavy ask for APAC execs.
- Option B: Staggered windows (recommended):
  * US block: 09:30–10:15 EDT (exec walkthrough + Q&A for US leadership)
  * EU block: 15:30–16:15 BST (highlighting compliance and integration bits for EU stakeholders)
  * APAC block: 09:00–09:45 JST (next day) (concise exec summary + recording + Q&A)

We considered daylight savings implications since the EU/US DST transitions can shift the comfortable overlap by an hour; the dates below are for the week of Apr 19 when both US and EU are already on DST — still, wanted to surface that explicitly.

Action items: can you confirm which option looks feasible for your execs and any hard-blocks (e.g., Rajiv unavailable before 16:00 BST)? Also flag if you'd prefer a single joined session with a recording vs. staggered short blocks.

I've attached a 1-page agenda and a timezone grid; Sergio will propose exact calendar windows after your preference.

Thanks,
Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
pri yom_das@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: RBW-demo-agenda-v3.pdf, timezone-grid-UTC-conversions.csv

From: Elaine Torres <elaine.torres@brightbyte.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 20:11:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Staggered demo windows — initial proposal

Hi Priyom,

Thanks — this is helpful context. Quick notes from our side:
- Rajiv and I both prefer shorter regional blocks rather than a single late overlap.
- Our EU exec (CRO) is only available 15:00–16:00 CEST on Mon/Tue and after 17:00 CEST on Thu.
- APAC exec (Tokyo-based) is flexible mornings JST, but cannot do past 10:00 JST.

Given that, Option B sounds better. Two asks: 1) can we shift the EU window 30 minutes earlier if that helps align with US? 2) would you be able to provide a 20–25 minute recorded summary for APAC in case they need to watch asynchronously?

Elaine
VP of Product | Brightbyte Inc.
elaine.torres@brightbyte.com | +44 20 7946 02 11

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Torres <elaine.torres@brightbyte.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@brightbyte.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staggered demo windows — initial proposal

Elaine — thanks for the clarity. Two rapid adjustments and a concrete suggestion below.

1) Move EU window 30 min earlier: makes sense, we can target 15:00–15:45 BST (which should map to 10:00–10:45 EDT on the same day during DST).
2) Recording + short APAC summary: happy to record the US/EU sessions and present a 20–25 minute concise recording for APAC. We can also schedule a short live Q&A in the APAC morning for any live follow-up.

Suggested blocked schedule (week of Apr 19):
- US: Mon Apr 19, 09:45–10:30 EDT (Priyom + PM + 20 min exec walkthrough, 25 min Q&A)
- EU: Mon Apr 19, 14:00–14:45 BST (slightly earlier than requested to reduce drift with US)
- APAC: Tue Apr 20, 09:00–09:30 JST (recording distributed + 15 min live follow-up if needed)

I am attaching a .ics that contains tentative windows for everyone's calendar. If these times look OK to you, I'll send final invites including a single Zoom that will be used for recording.

Sergio
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: staggered-invite-windows.ics

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Elaine Torres <elaine.torres@brightbyte.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:46:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Staggered demo windows — confirming EU shift

Quick note from ops: switching the EU window to 14:00 BST on Mon Apr 19 will bump the US window earlier than Priyom's calendar blockers. Can we do 14:15 BST / 09:45 EDT instead? That keeps the EU exec happy and avoids waking the APAC exec too early the next day.

Also, please confirm whether we should enable joined call recording and captions (some legal teams need consent language). Elaine, if Brightbyte requires a particular consent line, let us know and we'll add it to the invites.

Marissa
Product Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Elaine Torres <elaine.torres@brightbyte.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 17:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Staggered demo windows — confirming EU shift

Marissa — 14:15 BST / 09:45 EDT works for the EU/US windows. For recording consent, Brightbyte is fine with on-call verbal consent; please include the line: "This call will be recorded for internal training and follow-up; please speak up if you do not consent."

Rajiv and I are good with the APAC 09:00 JST follow-up as proposed. Please send invites and a link to the recording after the US/EU session so Rajiv can share internally.

Thanks,
Elaine

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Torres <elaine.torres@brightbyte.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@brightbyte.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Final schedule and invites (staggered windows confirmed)

- US live: Mon Apr 19, 09:45–10:30 EDT (Priyom + PM) — Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=demo
- EU live: Mon Apr 19, 14:15–15:00 BST (Sergio + Marissa) — same Zoom, recording ON (consent line included in invite)
- APAC follow-up: Tue Apr 20, 09:00–09:30 JST — 20–25 min recorded recap + 15 min live Q&A slot; recording will be shared immediately after EU session.
